PLAN 12 | THE WORLD CONTINUES

DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9

CHARACTER REFERENCES

{{CHAR_ZAHHAK}} @Zahhak (look 8)  {{CHAR_MARKET_PEOPLE}} @Chinese People (look 1) @Chinese People (look 3) @Chinese People (look 2)  {{CHAR_DOCK_WORKERS}} @Chinese People (look 3) 

LOCATION REFERENCES

{{LOC_BALCONY}} @Zahhak Balcony (look 1)  {{LOC_NIGHT_MARKET}} @China Port Night Dock (look 1) @China Bazaar (look 1)   {{LOC_WORKING_QUAY}} @China Port Night Dock (look 2) 

PROP REFERENCES

{{PROP_ZAHHAK_STAFF}}  {{PROP_MARKET_STALLS}}  {{PROP_MOORING_ROPE}}  {{PROP_MERCHANT_BOATS}}

DIRECTION AND CONTINUITY

Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence. Preserve each referenced identity, costume, proportions and rigid handmade mask; mask geometry and eye openings remain fixed. All visible humans wear their referenced masks. Emotion comes from posture, hands, breath and visible eyes. Each listed hard cut changes the physical camera station, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement follows a possible path and recovers focus on essential action. References anchor design; written lighting controls illumination. Tactile modern Iranian mythological design, analog realism and natural imperfections. NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

Zahhak remains unhurried and indifferent. Whenever he walks, show the staff planting first, weight transferring onto it, then the weaker leg following in an uneven step. Preserve the reference's weak-leg side. His two single-headed shoulder snakes remain alive, making small independent movements; preserve their attachment and proportions.

LOCATION AND LIGHT

Cold full night. Balcony rail lights barely define Zahhak's silhouette. The working harbor below is somewhat brighter, with practical loading lamps reflected in water. In quay details, a neutral work lamp reveals wet rope and a fixed bollard. The world remains visually functional.

START STATE AND BLOCKING

Zahhak is already stationary at the NORTH balcony rail facing the city below, staff planted, back to the hall. The machine is already running out of frame inside the residence. Night market lanes and working quay continue ordinary activity below; all visible people wear handmade masks.


PLAN 12 | SHOTS

SHOT 12-01 | 0s–2s | 2 SECONDS

50mm calm close profile from WEST of Zahhak at rail height. He looks down toward the harbor market; a serpent makes a small living adjustment near his shoulder. No arrival, no turn back, no response to the machine.

SHOT 12-02 | 2s–6s | 4 SECONDS

24mm high oblique from the balcony looking down along the direction of his gaze. Market lanes, stalls, porters and waterfront activity occupy layered depth. People buy, carry and walk independently. Let the eye leave the palace and enter this ordinary world.

SHOT 12-03 | 6s–9s | 3 SECONDS

40mm at market stall height from beside a customer. A masked vendor passes a wrapped purchase to the customer, who receives it and moves aside for the next person. Small handheld observation follows their hands, then releases them.

SHOT 12-04 | 9s–12s | 3 SECONDS

28mm lateral at street level from an intersecting lane. Two masked porters carry a basket together across frame while another worker steps aside. A quiet physical drift follows their shared effort. Nobody reacts to the palace.

SHOT 12-05 | 12s–15s | 3 SECONDS

65mm close at the quay: a worker's hands draw the final turn of a mooring hitch tight around a bollard. The distant machine sound ceases during the last second; normal water and rope sounds continue for a brief beat. CUT TO BLACK at 15 seconds. No return to Jamshid, machine or Zahhak.

END STATE AND EDIT

The last image belongs to ordinary work and ongoing city life. Machine sound has stopped off-screen. Cut to black and silence after the brief continuation of water. Do not show the omitted death.

SOUND

Running machine carried as a restrained editorial sound bridge, progressively beneath market foot traffic, packages, baskets, water and rope. No intelligible conversation. Machine stops near the final second, ordinary water remains briefly, then black and silence.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

END PROMPT
